messages:
ryan_sales: Hey team — onboarding ACME POC next week. They want to start on Hosted API but with least-privilege invites for their engineers and a short Dedicated trial window. Also they sent an infosec questionnaire (KMS / audit logs / SSO). Can someone own provisioning the workspace + scoped keys? Who do I loop in for Dedicated capacity checks?

kate_engineer: @ryan_sales yep — plan: create a new workspace `acme-poc`, then 2 roles: `poc-admin` (invite users, billing view) and `poc-runner` (create/rotate API keys, call generation/embeddings only). We can generate short-lived API keys scoped to routes/models. Example curl to create a scoped ephemeral key (internal CLI):

`redwood keys create --workspace acme-poc --scopes chat,embeddings --expires-in 14d --name "acme-poc-runner"`

That key will only allow `v1/chat` and `v1/embeddings` calls. For Hosted we can also set a spend cap and alerts so they don't go over. :thumbsup:

alex_sre: For Dedicated we need to know target model (e.g., meta-7b, llama-2-13b), expected sustained QPS, and average seq len/temperature. Lead time for a small reserved pool is ~3 business days to allocate and tune. If they need immediate performance testing, start on Hosted (with token limits) and then move to Dedicated once we confirm sizing.

omkar_sales: On pricing: we can offer a 30-day evaluation price for Dedicated (discounted commit) — I'll draft a proposal. For Hosted POC we can set a monthly cap and enable per-route throttling so costs are predictable. Is the customer ok with a capped trial?

kate_engineer: Regarding the security questionnaire:
- KMS/HSM: supported for Private and Dedicated (customer-managed keys for Private; integrated KMS for Dedicated).
- Audit logs: Enabled by default for Dedicated/Private; Hosted retains request logs 30 days by default (we can extend via add-on).
- SSO/SAML: we can enable SAML SSO for the workspace and require SCIM provisioning for teams.
- Network: for Private/VPC we need customer CIDR, allowed egress IPs, and any proxy rules.

If they want host-based encryption for logs or extra retention, that's an add-on (ops/security needs to sign off).

ryan_sales: Great. Can someone actually create the workspace and issue one `poc-runner` key scoped to `chat,embeddings`, expires 14 days? I will share ACME SRE contact details in DM. Also they asked: can we disable model switching on those keys so they only call the model we pre-approve?

kate_engineer: Yes — when creating the key we can pin `model` to a single model hash/alias, e.g. `--model redwood/meta-7b-v1`. That prevents switching. We'll create the key with model pin + route scope + expiry.

alex_sre: Quick note on least-priv: invite ACME engineers as members (no billing) and put only two people in `poc-admin`. Use ephemeral keys for CI; avoid long-lived keys on their side. We'll also enable audit webhook so customer's SOC can pull logs.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: #INC-2026-178901 - Dedicated capacity request & workspace provisioning. Assigned to @alex_sre and @kate_engineer.

omkar_sales: I'll attach a one-page pricing note + draft SOW and send to ACME today.

ryan_sales: Awesome — thanks. Next steps: @kate_engineer create workspace + key, @alex_sre kick off Dedicated sizing ticket, @omkar_sales send pricing. I'll update the customer once done. :raised_hands:
